figurative_meaning_en: An ideal brother devoted to his elder brother
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ভাইয়ের প্রতি তার ভক্তি ভাই লক্ষ্মণের মতো।
সে সত্যিকারের ভাই লক্ষ্মণ, কখনো ভাইকে ছেড়ে যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: His devotion to his brother is like that of Brother Lakshmana.
He is a true Brother Lakshmana, never abandoning his sibling.
history: Derived from the Ramayana epic, where Lakshmana, brother of Lord Rama, exemplifies unwavering loyalty by accompanying him into exile and protecting him throughout his trials.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology and is widely used in Bengali literature and everyday speech to praise fraternal devotion.
